sci-repo-y10-aran-2011-chem-mc-1.title: Year 10 Science — Chemistry test — Aranmore 2011 (original source MC)
sci-repo-y10-aran-2011-chem-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are all transition metals?
questions.explanation: Mn, Fe and Cu are transition metals.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are noble gases?
questions.explanation: Neon, argon and helium are noble gases.

options: (a) the number of total electrons an atom has.
(b) the number of electrons in the atom's outer shell.
(c) the number of electrons an atom has after it reacts.
(d) the number of electrons an atom has before it reacts.
questions.explanation: Valence electrons occupy the outer shell in this school model.

questions.prompt: The mass number of an element is how many ____________ there are one atom.
questions.explanation: Mass number is the total number of protons and neutrons.
